findings.title: Actual EOF callback tests establish command behavior, not every late-error or historical timing branch
findings.actual_evidence: Authorized test invokes actual draw end handler after await runTheNormalDraw has returned its settled result, checks exactly AUTHORIZE_FORK/FINALIZE and no CANCEL. Unauthorized silent case invokes actual EOF before any candidate and checks CANCEL/no FINALIZE plus failed/no image. Both actual handlers are reached. Reporting Writable EPIPE tests and stub transport-failure records are not direct draw/control socket error injections after candidate.
findings.impact: No new swallowing path found: child error and draw/control error handlers remain unconditional latching and final latched outcome is checked after domain proof. Static nonregression supports the narrow pilot recommendation. Do not claim comprehensive dynamic ECONNRESET/EPIPE-aftercandidate, closed-ack or in-flight EOF-to-receipt timing coverage from these tests.
findings.future_test_design: Under existing persistent OS guards, emit draw/control error and child error after the actual candidate/FINALIZE but before receipt/close, then let the same fake owner complete receipt/close; assert original failure, no image delivery, and owned terminal completion. Separately emit authorized EOF while FINALIZE is in flight. These are unexecuted designs; genuine fault runtime remains future scoped work, not a demand to reopen kernel algorithms.

closure.basis: Current supervisor onDrawEnd:2388 computes cacheDrawEndFailure(finalizeAfterOk), latches pre-finalize EOF failure, and requests CANCEL only when failure!==null. In-memory static replacement of the added comment+if block with the old unconditional call reconstructs exactly previous R5H SHA7706449e8f259a6e17e9ca2a40af8a5c344cef827a01c7881fc04a4a570b9b63. Thus the actual production delta is this guarded command plus comments; handlers and remaining lifecycle bytes unchanged.

Pre-finalize EOF still latches DRAW_EOF_BEFORE_FINALIZE and enters one-shot owned CANCEL. CHANNEL_ERROR/CUSTODIAN_ERROR handlers remain independent of finalizeAfterOk; #fail/terminal proof and final latch check prevent physical cleanup becoming business success. No new signal/group/identity/revoked/unknown authority change.
